description: Jest 30.5.2's text for a node:assert AssertionError that a test owns but that surfaces as an unhandled rejection (rejected while the test runs and never handled): jest-circus puts it in test.errors, and `formatNodeAssertErrors` maps every entry of test.errors at test_done. Kept: every stderr line that is not a stack frame, a test list line (those carry durations), a time, a count line or runner noise. A black-box run, read by `provino`'s `jest-node-assert.test.ts`.

run.keepLines: ^(?!\s+at )(?!ERROR: failed)(?!\(node:)(?!\(Use )(?!\s+✕)(?!\s+(?:inside a describe|nested)$)(?!\s+>?\s*\d+ \|)(?!\s+\| +\^)(?!Time:)(?!Ran all)(?!Test Suites:)(?!Tests:)(?!Snapshots:)(?!Test results)(?!\s*$)
